title: Head and Hand
label: ch:fr-head-and-hand
canDo: I can name the head and the hand in French with the right article, and point out the Latin manus hiding inside English manual, manufacture and maintain.

payoff.summary: Say la main with its nasal -ain, then run the manus family out loud — manual, manuscript, maintenir — and land on manufacture, 'made by hand', now the name for the opposite.
payoff.note: Chapter 17 has no terminal practice lesson, so the payoff is the last lesson by sequence; it exercises the main half of the chapter but not the tête half.
